task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.
joint_plan_text:
### Joint Plan — task3_abstract  (about 5 min / deadline 20 min: OK)

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] turn on the lamp next to the table  (r1_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] open the black laptop on the brown leather sofa  (r2_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] turn on the table lamp  (r3_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] turn on the desk lamp  (r4_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] adjust the white table lamp on the wooden side table  (r2_s2)
- R4 [LOCAL] move the trash bin from beside the desk to under the desk  (r4_s2)

R1.capability: I am a fixed robot with a gripper, able to manipulate light objects within reach.
has_items: vase with flowers (on the sideboard, image 2)
brown sofa (center of the room, image 2)
need_from_others: A mobile robot to check and tidy the desk area in the bedroom
intends: Ensure the lamp is turned on to provide lighting
R1.obs_scope: I can observe and interact with objects in the living room but cannot see or interact with objects in other rooms.
cannot_do: PushFurniture due to being fixed in place
R1.reasoning: a) The desk area must be presentable, and the user should have clear visibility and audibility for the video call. b) The most important aspect is ensuring the desk area is tidy and well-lit for the call. c) In my room, I can ensure the lamp is functioning to provide adequate lighting. d) None of my items are needed in another room.

R2.capability: I am a Mobile_Light robot capable of moving light objects and passing or receiving them.
has_items: black laptop (on the brown leather sofa, image 1)
wooden side table (next to the brown leather sofa, image 1)
white table lamp (on the wooden side table, image 1)
floor lamp (near the dining area, image 1)

potted plant (on the wooden TV stand, image 2)

need_from_others: A robot to turn on the bedroom light
intends: Ensure the black laptop is open and ready for the video call
Adjust the white table lamp to ensure the living room is well-lit
suggests: White table lamp: to improve lighting in the bedroom
R2.obs_scope: I can observe the living room and its contents but cannot see or interact with the bedroom.
cannot_do: PushFurniture due to lack of strength
SliceObject as I lack cutting tools
PourObject as I lack pouring mechanisms
R2.reasoning: a) The desk area must be tidy, well-lit, and equipped for clear audio and video. b) The priority is ensuring the desk area is presentable and functional for the video call. c) In my room, I can ensure the laptop is ready and the lighting is adequate. d) The white table lamp could be used to improve lighting in the bedroom.

R3.capability: I have a gripper and can manipulate light objects within my reach.
has_items: table lamp (on the wooden desk, image 1)
potted plant (on the wooden desk, image 1)
two monitors (on the corner desk, image 2)
blue mug (on the corner desk, image 2)
R3.obs_scope: I can observe the desk area and items on it, but cannot see other parts of the house.
R3.reasoning: a) The desk area must be tidy and well-lit for the video call. b) The priority is to ensure the desk is presentable and the lighting is adequate. c) I will turn on the table lamp to improve lighting. d) None of my items are needed in other rooms.

R4.capability: I am a mobile robot capable of moving objects up to 20 kg.
has_items: office chair (in front of the desk, image 1)
baseball bat (leaning against the wall, image 1)
need_from_others: Ensure the computer monitor and laptop are functioning for the video call
intends: Turn on the desk lamp to improve lighting
Move the trash bin under the desk to tidy the area
suggests: Desk lamp: improve lighting for the video call
R4.obs_scope: I can observe the bedroom and its contents but cannot observe other rooms.
cannot_do: SliceObject because I lack cutting tools
PourObject because I lack pouring mechanisms
R4.reasoning: a) The desk area must be tidy, well-lit, and free of distractions for a clear video call. b) The most important aspect is ensuring the desk area is presentable and well-lit. c) I will turn on the desk lamp and ensure the desk area is tidy. d) The desk lamp can be used to improve lighting in another room if needed.
